title: 2026 Holiday Shopping at Target: Answers to Guests’ Most Frequently Asked Questions
summary: The most frequently asked questions about shopping at Target during the holidays, including return policy, Early Black Friday deals, Deal of the Day and more.
body_markdown:
## Deals and promotions


Q:


When are Target's Early Black Friday deals?


A:


You can take advantage of[Early Black Friday deals](https://www.target.com/c/target-black-friday/-/N-5q0f2) from Nov. 5-7.


Q:


What are Target's top Early Black Friday deals?


A:


Target’s top[Early Black Friday deals](https://www.target.com/c/target-black-friday/-/N-5q0f2) include:


- 40% off sweatshirts & sweatpants
- 40% off select toys
- 40% off lights, wreaths, garlands & porch pots
- Up to 50% off kitchen appliances
- 30% off **Levi’s** apparel


Q:


Where can I find Target's latest holiday deals?


A:


You can discover the latest holiday deals on Target.com, the Target app and through the[Target Weekly Ad](https://www.target.com/weekly-ad?promo=Target-20261025) .


Q:


What is Target's Deal of the Day, and how can I take advantage of these limited-time offers?


A:


[Deal of the Day](https://www.target.com/c/target-deal-of-the-day/-/N-2sbk4) offers a limited-time, one-day-only deal on popular products and must-have gifts. A new daily deal will be available every day from Nov. 1 through Dec. 24. New this year, you can preview the next day's featured Deal of the Day one day in advance, making it easier to plan ahead and score the deals you want.


Q:


Will Target offer additional deals throughout the holiday season?


A:


Yes. Guests can look forward to limited-time offers most Thursdays through Saturdays throughout the holiday season, as well as sales for key moments like Black Friday and Cyber Monday.


Q:


Can I combine holiday deals, coupons, Target Circle offers and gift card promotions?


A:


Some offers can be combined, depending on the promotion. You should review each offer's terms and conditions for eligible items, purchase requirements and exclusions. Here is additional information about[coupons and deals](https://www.target.com/help/articles/promotions-coupons/coupon-deals) and[current promotions](https://www.target.com/help/articles/promotions-coupons/current-promotions) .


Q:


Does Target price match holiday deals?


A:


Beginning Nov. 1 through Dec. 24,[Target's Holiday Price Match Guarantee](https://www.target.com/help/article/000062256) helps you shop with confidence by matching Target's own prices if they go lower later in the season.
